-- Build the full profile query for at-risk fans
WITH fan_profiles AS (
    SELECT 
        f.user_registry,
        f.nick_label,
        f.tier_step,
        f.pts_val,
        e.soc_int_score,
        e.eng_rate,
        e.avg_sess_count,
        e.act_days_wk,
        m.memb_kind,
        m.memb_days,
        m.spend_usd,
        r.churn_flag,
        l.trust_val,
        l.loy_pts,
        r.ref_count
    FROM retentionandinfluence r
    JOIN engagement e ON r.retain_engage_pivot = e.engage_reg
    JOIN membershipandspending m ON e.engage_member_pivot = m.member_reg
    JOIN fans f ON m.member_fan_pivot = f.user_registry
    LEFT JOIN loyaltyandachievements l ON r.retain_loyalty_pivot = l.loyalty_reg
),
at_risk AS (
    SELECT * FROM fan_profiles WHERE churn_flag = 'High'
),
all_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(soc_int_score) as avg_soc_int,
        AVG(eng_rate) as avg_eng_rate,
        AVG(avg_sess_count) as avg_avg_sess,
        AVG(memb_days) as avg_memb_days,
        AVG(spend_usd) as avg_spend,
        COUNT(*) as total_count
    FROM fan_profiles
)
SELECT 
    ar.user_registry,
    ar.nick_label,
    ar.tier_step,
    ar.churn_flag,
    ar.soc_int_score,
    ar.eng_rate,
    ar.avg_sess_count,
    ar.memb_kind,
    ar.memb_days,
    ar.spend_usd,
    ar.trust_val,
    ar.loy_pts,
    -- Rankings compared to all fans
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ar.soc_int_score DESC) as soc_int_rank,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ar.eng_rate DESC) as eng_rate_rank,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ar.spend_usd DESC) as spend_rank,
    RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ar.loy_pts DESC) as loyalty_rank,
    a.total_count as total_fans_tracked,
    ROUND(CAST(a.avg_soc_int AS numeric), 2) as overall_avg_soc_int,
    ROUND(CAST(a.avg_eng_rate AS numeric), 3) as overall_avg_eng_rate,
    ROUND(CAST(a.avg_spend AS numeric), 2) as overall_avg_spend
FROM at_risk ar
CROSS JOIN all_stats a
ORDER BY ar.user_registry;
